title: Law to create business incubators for disabled entrepreneurs
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a three-year pilot program with at least one business incubator site in each borough for people with disabilities who own or want to own a business. The sites would offer training, mentorship and connections to funding and jobs, and the agency would conduct public outreach and file annual reports to the Council. The bill also clarifies that the agency leads workforce development efforts for people with disabilities.
